summary: Iteration 4 backend verification PASSED. 45/45 pytest cases passing (33 prior + 12 new). All new Iteration 4 behaviors verified end-to-end: (1) GET /api/thoughts requires Bearer (401) and returns [] for a fresh seeded user. (2) POST /api/thoughts creates a thought (id prefix 'thought_', archived:false) and GET lists them newest-first. (3) POST /api/thoughts with empty text and whitespace-only text both return 400. (4) DELETE /api/thoughts/{id} removes a thought; deleting a non-existent id returns 404. (5) POST /api/thoughts/{id}/convert?date=YYYY-MM-DD creates a one-time task with the thought's text on the given date, archives the thought so it disappears from GET /thoughts, and the new task is visible in GET /api/tasks?date=YYYY-MM-DD. (6) Thoughts are per-user isolated — user B cannot see or delete user A's thoughts (B's delete returns 404). (7) PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with {notes:'green bottle'} persists on subsequent GET. (8) PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with {notes:''} clears notes to an empty string. (9) PATCH accepts both title and notes together. All 33 pre-existing tests still pass (auth gating, tasks CRUD, complete/uncomplete, snooze via PATCH, reorder/sort_index, current+best streak, daily-content cache, force=true rate-limit per-user).

minor.issue: Decorator @api_router.get('/streak') is declared twice (server.py:423-424). Harmless because FastAPI overwrites the route, but it's dead code that should be removed.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove the duplicate '@api_router.get("/streak")' line at server.py:423 — only one decorator is needed.
No functional fixes needed. All Iteration 4 endpoints work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Thoughts collection schema matches spec: {id, user_id, text, created_at, archived:false} on insert (server.py:365-373). GET filters via {'archived': {'$ne': True}} so legacy docs without the field would also be included — correct for forward compatibility.
GET /api/thoughts strips _id and user_id from the projection (server.py:354-356) — no ObjectId serialization risk and user_id is not leaked in the response.
POST /api/thoughts trims whitespace and rejects empty strings with 400 (server.py:362-364) — symmetric with how task titles are validated.

Convert flow is atomic in practice: task is inserted first, then thought is marked archived (server.py:408-412). If the archive update failed after the task insert, the user would have both a task AND a still-visible thought; consider wrapping in a Mongo transaction or reversing the order. Low risk on a single-node Mongo.
DELETE /api/thoughts/{id} hard-deletes (server.py:378), while convert soft-archives. This is intentional and consistent with the spec but worth documenting.

PATCH /tasks notes uses `if body.notes is not None` (server.py:290-291), correctly distinguishing 'no change' (omitted/None) from 'clear to empty string' (''). Verified by test_patch_notes_empty_clears.
Per-user isolation is enforced on all thought endpoints by filtering on user_id (server.py:353, 378, 386, 410). Verified by test_thoughts_are_per_user_isolated.
Startup index on thoughts (user_id asc, created_at desc) at server.py:607 matches the dominant query pattern.
Minor: duplicate decorator at server.py:423-424 — see backend_issues.minor.
